description: The WHEN OTHER arm of READNEXT-TRANSACT-FILE at app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl:646-652, forced to strike AFTER the browse has been positioned and one row painted. The failure sets WS-ERR-FLG, so the IF at :299 is false and the row is not painted, and the loop at :297 exits on ERR-FLG-ON with WS-IDX at two. Control takes the ELSE at :314 - not because of end-of-file but because of the error flag, since :305 tests BOTH conditions - so NEXT-PAGE-NO is set at :315 and, WS-IDX (2) being greater than one, :317-318 bumps the page number to one. The screen is then sent a second time at :326 even though the read failed, because :283's guard was passed before the failure occurred. That is the behaviour, and it is why the send count is two rather than one as in case07. MAIN-PARA's first-entry branch performs BOTH PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :115 AND SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN at :116, so this path sends one more time than PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD does on its own - the last send is :116's and it re-paints the same screen with WS-MESSAGE unchanged. The refusal is reached through the only seam that can reach it: the read is told to refuse rather than being handed data that cannot refuse, and it is the SECOND read that refuses, which is what leaves exactly one row painted and WS-IDX at two. WHERE THESE NUMBERS COME FROM: every value here was derived STATICALLY, by reading app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl paragraph by paragraph and cross-checking four authorities - the 350-byte layout of app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy, the X(n) widths of the fifty-nine output items of app/cpy-bms/COTRN00.CPY from :373, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COTRN00.bms, and the CT00-to-COTRN00C binding at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:419-420. It was NEVER captured from a running COBOL program: there is no z/OS runtime here, no CICS emulator, and the three IBM-supplied copybooks DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from this repository. Twenty cases, field-by-field diffing and a diff count that must be zero all survive that substitution; only the provenance of the numbers differs, and it is stated here rather than left implicit. BYTES: each of the twelve seeded rows is exactly 350 characters with CVTRA05Y's trailing FILLER X(20) space-filled rather than dropped, because omitting it would move every later offset and change the record width; TRAN-AMT is the eleven-byte zoned S9(09)V99 with its sign overpunched into the trailing byte and read at scale two; both timestamps are pinned at twenty-six characters, and the clock is pinned too because :569 reads FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE on every send; the code page is named US-ASCII and never taken from the platform; and page size ten is behaviour read off the loop bounds at :290, :297 and :344, not a tunable. MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :531 truncates X(80) into X(78) on the RIGHT, so the two channels are pinned at their own widths rather than one being computed from the other. STATELESSNESS: EIBCALEN 218 is the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy plus the 58-byte CDEMO-CT00-INFO declared at :61-70; that whole area and the AID arrive in the payload and leave in it, and nothing whatever is retained between invocations. NO RECORD EXPECTATION: STARTBR, READNEXT, READPREV and ENDBR are this program's entire file surface - there is no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE in its 699 lines - so expectedWrites, expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are empty by design, and a duplicate-key or not-found status cannot arise anywhere in this folder. NAMING: the class this projects onto is called TransactionMenuController because that name is mandated, but COTRN00C's own header at :5 reads Function : List Transactions from TRANSACT file - it LISTS, with PF7/PF8 paging and a per-row selection cell, and it is no menu; every assertion here is taken from the paired source and none from the name. NUMBERING, for a reader arriving from the plan: in this realized suite case08 is READNEXT's refusal, case07 is STARTBR's refusal at :612-618, and the PF8 already-at-the-bottom guard of :267-273 - where TRNID-LAST is moved to TRAN-ID at :262 and then discarded, SEND-ERASE-NO is set at :272 and the un-erased SEND at :542 is taken - is case12. That divergence is recorded rather than resolved by renumbering, because case08 is the only case that reaches :646 and duplicating case12 here would delete that arm's only coverage.
